resources.string: One Pause notices when you open an app you chose to protect and shows a short breathing pause before you continue. For website protection it also checks supported browser address bars against your chosen domains. Data stays on your device.

Adds a deactivation step before uninstalling One Pause. This does not make removal impossible. You can deactivate the guard in Android Settings at any time. No password, screen lock, or erase-device controls are requested.
Turning this off removes the extra uninstall step. App protection continues until you disable its accessibility service.
